security._research_note: allow_network=false and an empty allowed_domains list mean /code/solve's optional reference_urls are silently ignored (no fetch ever happens). To opt in: set allow_network=true and add exact hostnames (e.g. 'docs.python.org') here. Every fetch attempt, allowed or denied, is written to data/security/research_ledger.jsonl -- see pfai/research_gate.py.

model._note: The API key itself is NEVER stored here — set it as the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable / platform secret. Switch provider to 'echo' for offline/dev mode, or 'openai_compatible' for a local Ollama/vLLM server (use api_key_env for any gateway secret).

continuous_training._enable_note: Base switch is true. Force disable/enable at runtime with PFAI_CONTINUOUS_TRAINING_ENABLED. auto_promote is never honored from JSON — promotion stays owner-gated.
